def solve(inp):
    H=len(inp);W=len(inp[0])
    seeds=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==5]
    r0,c0=seeds[0]
    shape=[(i-r0,j-c0) for i,j in seeds]
    matches=[]
    for di in range(H):
        for dj in range(W):
            cells=[(di+a,dj+b) for a,b in shape]
            if all(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and inp[x][y]==0 for x,y in cells):
                matches.append(cells)
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    for cells in matches:
        for x,y in cells: out[x][y]=5
    return out, matches
